name: create-layer-version
description: Reviewed native management transport; explicit user session required. zipFile contains Base64 ZIP bytes; validate compressed/decompressed limits and entry count before authorization. Layer name creates the initial version or appends a version. AGCLI 1.12.0 local ZIP validation caps files below 50MiB; this direct API adapter uses the current browser-reviewed guide limits of 150MiB compressed, 300MiB expanded and 30000 entries. This difference and modern runtime wire values still require cloud verification.
